name: devctl
description: Composable architecture, documentation, review, TDD, and delivery guidance for software projects.

interface.shortDescription: Build and document consistent software systems.
interface.longDescription: Devctl provides composable project-shaping, product and system documentation, code review, contract-design, backend, frontend, Obsidian plugin, outside-in TDD, and behavior-preserving simplification skills.
defaultPrompt: Create a Devctl project manifest for this repository.
Establish or reconcile this project's product and architecture documentation.
Review a staged diff, commit, or pull request for requirements, engineering, and architecture risks.
Design a Devctl-managed service and its API contract.
Build an Obsidian plugin with React surfaces and lifecycle-safe tests.
